sources.title: GitHub - adambuttrick/ror-set-point-matching · GitHub
sources.snippet: It maps OpenAlex institution IDs to ROR IDs, for the teacher judgments and for answers with OpenAlex institution IDs. Its teacher judgments: 3.8 million judgments of (string, institution) pairs by Jev, a decision model from TypeSafe AI.
